DIAGNOSIS READY: Hirschsprung Disease.

The clinical picture of abdominal distension, feeding difficulties, and pain on palpation, combined with the indication of obstructive features in your history, strongly points to a failure of the bowel to relax. This is consistent with Hirschsprung disease, where the absence of nerve cells prevents normal bowel movement. Have you noticed if the baby has passed any stool since birth or if the diarrhea has been explosive in nature?
